description: Na₂FeP₂(HO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one H and five O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.61 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.85 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PHO₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.19 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to one H and three O atoms to form distorted PHO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-56°. The P-H bond length is 1.41 Å. All P-O bond lengths are 1.54 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to one H and three O atoms to form distorted PHO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-44°. The P-H bond length is 1.41 Å. All P-O bond lengths are 1.54 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one P atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom.
